title: Intelligent Routing Chains
summary: This module provides various chain implementations for intelligently routing user inputs to different downstream chains or components. It supports routing based on embedding similarity or decisions made by a large language model (LLM).

nodes.label: Route by Embedding Similarity
nodes.title: EmbeddingRouterChain
nodes.description: Routes incoming queries to a specific destination based on the semantic similarity of the query to predefined descriptions stored in a vector database.

nodes.label: Route by LLM Decision
nodes.title: LLMRouterChain
nodes.description: Directs queries to different downstream chains by leveraging an LLM to decide the appropriate destination and extract relevant inputs.

nodes.label: Route to Multiple Prompts
nodes.title: MultiPromptChain
nodes.description: Manages routing user inputs to one of several specialized prompt-based LLM chains, using an LLM-driven router to make the selection.

nodes.label: Route to Multiple Retrieval QA Chains
nodes.title: MultiRetrievalQAChain
nodes.description: Routes user queries to the most suitable retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) chain from a collection, based on an LLM's routing decision.

nodes.label: Vector Database
nodes.title: VectorStore
nodes.description: Stores and retrieves vector embeddings of text, enabling semantic similarity searches for routing decisions.

nodes.label: Text Embeddings
nodes.title: Embeddings
nodes.description: Generates numerical representations of text, capturing semantic meaning for similarity comparisons.

nodes.label: LLM Processing Chain
nodes.title: LLMChain
nodes.description: A sequence that combines a language model with a prompt template to generate responses.

nodes.label: Language Model (LLM)
nodes.title: BaseLanguageModel
nodes.description: A foundational model capable of understanding and generating human-like text.

nodes.label: Prompt Template
nodes.title: BasePromptTemplate
nodes.description: Defines the structure and content for prompts sent to language models.

nodes.label: Retrieval QA Chain
nodes.title: BaseRetrievalQA
nodes.description: A chain designed to answer questions by retrieving relevant information from a knowledge base.

nodes.label: Generic Chain
nodes.title: Chain
nodes.description: A fundamental building block in LangChain, representing a sequence of operations.

nodes.label: Document Data
nodes.title: Document
nodes.description: Represents a piece of text content, often with associated metadata, used in vector stores.

nodes.label: Parse Router Output
nodes.title: RouterOutputParser
nodes.description: Interprets the output of an LLM to extract routing decisions and next inputs.

groups.label: Routing Chains
groups.title: Core Routing Mechanisms
groups.description: These components provide the primary interfaces for directing inputs to different processing paths.

groups.label: Generative AI Components
groups.title: LLM and Prompting
groups.description: Components related to large language models and their interaction via prompts and chains.

groups.label: Data Management
groups.title: Data Storage and Representation
groups.description: Components responsible for storing, representing, and retrieving data, especially for semantic search.

groups.label: Analytical Tools
groups.title: Output Parsing and Interpretation
groups.description: Components focused on interpreting and structuring the outputs from other processes, particularly LLMs.
